title: Darwin proved right about gnat-trapping carnivorous plant | New Scientist
description: Botanists have finally proved what Charles Darwin was unable to nail down – that a genus of plants known to catch insects also digests them, suggesting the extent of plant carnivory has been underestimated
author: James Woodford

title: Canadian wildfires are reducing solar power generation in Europe | New Scientist
description: Lost solar power due to smoke blocking the sun cost Europe and North America nearly $2 billion in 2023 alone
author: Michael Le Page

title: Parts of the UK endure first ever month without any rain | New Scientist
description: For the first time since records began, there was no rain at all for parts of southern England and Wales in July, in a “truly exceptional” month of heat and sunshine
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Why winner of biggest prize in maths has decided to work on AI instead | New Scientist
description: Jacob Tsimerman won a Fields medal last month – now he is leaving mathematics to work on AI safety
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: OpenAI announces solutions to 10 longstanding maths problems | New Scientist
description: Ten conundrums that stumped human mathematicians for years have been cracked by OpenAI's Astra model, continuing a hot streak of AI-driven breakthroughs that are shaking up the field
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Why sitting under a parasol is barely cooler than being in the sun | New Scientist
description: A beach umbrella might protect you from sunburn, but when it comes to keeping you cool, it makes surprisingly little difference
author: Michael Le Page
